mentions.name: Dreamcast Wipeout-inspired racing game engine
mentions.description: This project is a game engine for the Sega Dreamcast, including an editor and tooling, built to power a racing game inspired by Wipeout. It explicitly does not use AI.
mentions.source_excerpt: A Sega Dreamcast game engine (with editor and tooling) for a Wipeout inspired racing game. No AI.
mentions.author: chromadon
